theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_fli_tangent_tilt_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (W : Varifold N n U) (P T : Grassmannian N n) (y : Euclidean N) (θ ε : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W y T θ → 1 ≤ θ → 0 ≤ ε → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → (∫⁻ z in closedBall y ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap z.2 - Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖ ∂W.measure) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε * ρ ^ n)) → ∀ v : Euclidean N, ‖Grassmannian.project T v - Grassmannian.project P v‖ ≤ ε / (unitBallVolume n).toReal * ‖v‖
